name: Haramasete Hitozuma 2
source:
Kiyoshi is fired.... He thinks why he can't always live a good life. Yes, this is because of Shiro, his father, and friends. His grudges gradually grow bigger and he finally decides to take revenge on them. At first, Tsuyoshi, his older brother. He chooses Tsubame, Tsuyoshi's wife, as the first target girl. Next, Ryuji, his ex-coworker. Ryuji's wife is Rin. Kiyoshi was actually in love with her when he was a university student. Ryuji, however, stole and married her! Lastly, Hanae, Shiro's current wife. He chooses Mika, their daughter, as the third target girl. Like this, his revenge plan is carried out now....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Kiyoshi被解雇了……他思考为什么自己不能一直过上好日子。是的，这是因为白、他的父亲和朋友们。他的怨恨逐渐变大，他终于决定向他们报仇。首先是他的哥哥刚。他选择刚的妻子燕作为第一个目标女孩。接下来是他的前同事龙司。龙司的妻子是凛。事实上，清志在大学时就爱上了她。然而龙司却抢走了她并娶了她！最后是花惠，白的现任妻子。他选择他们的女儿米卡作为第三个目标女孩。就这样，他的复仇计划现在就开始实施了……

[来自工口游戏商店]
